name: comp-440

frames.best_why: A clean white Projects tooltip sits above the highlighted tab with its content line below.

tagline: Three wordless icon tabs that name themselves in a bubble on hover.
summary: A small dark tab bar holding only a house, a panels glyph and a cube; hovering pops up the tab's name, and a 3 badge rides the middle icon.
appearance: A compact dark rounded bar on black holds three icon-only tabs: a house, a window-panels glyph and a cube. The selected tab is hugged by a lighter rounded block, and a white tooltip bubble floats above with a small name.
behaviour: Hovering an icon lifts a white label bubble above the bar; clicking selects that icon and swaps the single line of content below. The middle icon keeps a small 3 badge.
demo_content: Names Overview, Projects and Packages, the count 3, and the lines Content for Tab 1 and 2.
search_phrases: icon only tabs with labels on hover
tabs that show tooltip when hovered
unlabeled tabs with pop up hints
quiet tab bar for a small app
use_when: Saving space in a cramped toolbar where the three icons are already familiar to users.
avoid_when: When icons are ambiguous: no name appears until hover, so touch users never see one.
customise: Icon choice, tooltip names, the 3 badge and content lines are written inside; changing them means editing the triggers. Sizing and spacing are classes.
weight_why: Three icons, small tooltips and a badge; only light opacity and panel transitions.

a11y.note: The icons are aria-hidden and the triggers carry no aria-label, so screen readers announce unnamed tabs.

issues: Tabs have no accessible names: icons are hidden and no text label is supplied.
Names exist only as hover tooltips, so touch users cannot tell the tabs apart.
polish_why: Compact and tidy, but overlapping tooltips mid-hover and invisible labels feel cramped.
title: Icon Tooltip Tabs
